observations: Photo 0 shows a white industrial sewing machine on a white table with a metal frame, placed against a pink wall. The machine has a foot pedal and a thread stand. The table has a blue tray under the pedal.
Photo 1 shows the same setup from a slightly different angle, with the same pink wall background. The machine appears to be in used condition with some dirt and wear.
Photo 2 is nearly identical to photo 1, showing the same machine and table setup. The machine has visible signs of use, including scuffs and dirt on the body.
The machine has a needle, presser foot, and thread stand. The table has a ruler along the edge. The foot pedal is connected to a power cord.
No brand or model name is visible on the machine or table in any photo.
The seller claims it is an 'Industrial Sewing Machine' and priced at '290k pH' (likely a typo for 'NGN').

claims.evidence: The machine has features typical of an industrial sewing machine: large needle, presser foot, thread stand, and foot pedal. The setting (industrial table) supports the claim.

The price is stated as '290k pH', which is likely a typo for 'NGN' (Nigerian Naira). The amount is not visible in any photo, and no proof of value is provided. The seller's text alone is insufficient to verify the price.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation, including the needle moving, thread feeding, and foot pedal response.

risks.risk: Machine may have electrical or mechanical issues (e.g., motor failure, worn gears)
risks.proof: Close-up of the motor, gears, and electrical connections, and a video of the machine running.

risks.risk: Machine may be missing parts (e.g., bobbin case, accessories, or manual)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included parts laid out, or a video of the machine being assembled.

risks.risk: Machine may have been used in hazardous conditions (e.g., near fire, chemicals)
risks.proof: Photo of the machine's interior or any warning labels, or a video showing the machine being cleaned or inspected.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation, including needle movement and foot pedal response.
Close-up photos of the motor, gears, and electrical connections.
Photo showing all included parts (bobbin case, accessories, manual, etc.).
Photo of the machine's interior or any warning labels.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
